facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal says many Burundian ministries and agencies run their own disparate servers, making intra-government data exchange difficult in the absence of shared solutions for data hosting and interoperability.

The World Bank's US$50 million Digital Foundations Project (PAD4690) will finance a national data exchange layer, including its connection to information systems, and technical specifications for a national data exchange solution; the document does not say any platform is yet built (date is the document's published date).
